headings.usage: Use for all page titles, section headers, and modal titles. Tracking tight.

body.usage: Use for all standard text, inputs, and data tables.

mono.usage: Use for Box IDs, Timestamps, and SKU-like data.

cards.style: Flat with subtle border, no shadow by default. Hover: shadow-lg transition-all duration-300

inputs.style: Minimalist, border-b-2 focus:border-primary focus:ring-0 bg-transparent px-0 rounded-none

visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle grain overlay on the main background to give a 'paper' feel.
visual_enhancers.micro_interactions: Buttons scale down slightly on click. List items slide in staggered.

instructions_to_main_agent.general: Build a responsive, accessible personal inventory app. Use the provided color palette to override Tailwind defaults in index.css. Implement the 'Bento' grid for the dashboard.
instructions_to_main_agent.voice_search: Implement Web Speech API. Create a visual indicator (pulsing mic icon) when listening. Fallback to text input if API is unavailable.
instructions_to_main_agent.printing: Create a specific 'Print View' component that strips navigation and styles the list for A4 paper using @media print CSS.
instructions_to_main_agent.data_management: Use local state or context for the prototype. Ensure Box IDs are auto-generated and unique.
instructions_to_main_agent.accessibility: Ensure all text meets APCA contrast standards against the 'Bone White' background. Use semantic HTML.

universal_guidelines: Do not use generic centered layouts.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
